the_correction.the_fix: `verify(document)` -- the existing whole-bundle digest check, including the frozen running-command identity check at an installed entry point -- runs BEFORE the command is printed. Nothing new validates; the verifier that already refused this was simply not being asked.
the_correction.what_was_wrong: `instance.main` answered `command` from `read` alone. `read` validates the SELECTOR -- its members, the layout it derives, the containment of every path -- and says nothing about the bytes at the end of them. All four recipes execute what it prints, so a changed launcher, a changed library or an unbound extra file in the bundle was EXECUTED and `just status <instance>` returned 0. A runtime cannot check its own bytes once it has been loaded.
the_correction.why_the_other_answers_are_still_reads: `state`, `logs` and `destination` are where an operator looks when a deployment is broken, and nothing executes them. A runtime that no longer verifies must not also take away the means of finding out why -- which is its own check, and its own probe.

the_runbook_alignment.normal_ux_is_the_installed_instance: the opening example is now `just build` + `just bootstrap inputs.json <destination> <distro>` and the four lifecycle commands taking `instance.json`; running from the checkout with four exported operands is presented as the older form, for developing on the stack itself.
the_runbook_alignment.the_lock_scope_is_qualified: `.bootstrap.lock` coordinates bootstraps that both take it AND NOTHING ELSE; the exclusive publication from an owned temporary is what makes the last step safe regardless.
the_runbook_alignment.verify_before_execute_is_documented: the runtime is verified before the command runs, not after; `state`, `logs` and `destination` are still answered for a deployment whose runtime no longer verifies.
the_runbook_alignment.who_needs_the_checkout: `just <verb> <instance.json>` still needs this checkout to ask `tools.instance` where the installed command is; the installed command itself needs nothing from here, and the runbook shows that form.
